name: CR33P
source:
Your friend Dove invites you to a group chat to make some new friends. Everyone is so different but so friendly! They all seem so interested in you—too interested. Have fun navigating online relationships!

(Or don't)

[From [url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/cr33p]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的朋友Dove邀请你加入群聊以结交一些新朋友。每个人都如此不同，但又如此友好！他们似乎都对你很感兴趣——太感兴趣了。享受在线关系中的乐趣！

（或者不）

[来自[url=https://try-froggery.itch.io/cr33p]itch.io[/url]]
